name: Kazamatsuri Rin
source:
The elder sister of the main character. She is calm, not matching her appearance.

She is quite a naughty girl. She sometimes wears panties and no bra.

She collects cacti and often kills them.

She is good at fundraising.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/q_bon/chara/gense.html]official site[/url]]
